conditions.evidence: assess breast cancer response to neoadjuvant chemotherapy
conditions.label: breast cancer

output.population: Patients in a longitudinal study of breast cancer response to neoadjuvant chemotherapy, imaged at four treatment time points.
output.summary: Longitudinal breast dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI acquired before, during and after neoadjuvant chemotherapy, shared as a multicenter data analysis challenge for developing and validating quantitative imaging measures of treatment response.
